title: 24/7 Emergency Plumbing
headline:
Burst pipe at 11pm?
I'll usually answer.
shortDescription: After-hours and weekend dispatch for burst pipes, mainline backups, water-heater failures, and active leaks — within Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and NW Portland.
lead: Plumbing emergencies don't keep business hours. Most of mine come in between 9pm and 6am or on a Sunday afternoon — a frozen line letting go in January, a 12-year-old water heater that finally split, a mainline backup that started during dinner. When you call, I'll usually answer myself. If I'm already on another call, I'll text back inside 15 minutes with an honest ETA. No call center, no "a technician will reach out shortly," no surprise dispatch fee tacked on after the work is done.

sections.heading: What this covers
sections.intro: The actual emergencies — the kind where shutting the water off won't hold until Monday.

items.label: Burst supply line
items.body: Frozen pipes, failed compression fittings, an old galvanized run that finally let go. Stop the leak, stabilize the line, repair-or-replace decision in writing

items.label: Mainline backup
items.body: Toilets gurgling, lowest-fixture overflow, water in the basement floor drain. Cabled or jetted same-night, scoped after to confirm

items.label: Water heater failure
items.body: Tank cracked open, no hot water, gas smell at the unit. Shut off and stabilized tonight, replacement same-day or first thing in the morning

items.label: Active leak from above
items.body: Ceiling staining and dripping under a bathroom or kitchen above. Isolate, demo a small access patch, repair the line, photo report so your insurance has documentation

items.label: Sewage backup
items.body: Black-water in a fixture or floor drain. Cleared, scoped, and a written estimate for any pipe damage we find. Restoration referral if you need one

items.label: After-hours fee — $125
items.body: Added on top of standard flat-rate or per-job pricing for evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays. No additional dispatch fee, no trip charge

sections.heading: Service area & response time
sections.body: I keep emergency dispatch within a tight Westside radius so I can actually be there in time to help.
items: Cedar Mill, Bethany, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and NW Portland (97225, 97229, 97006, 97005, 97124, 97210, 97231) — typical 30 to 60 minute arrival
When you call after hours, you reach me directly. If I'm under a sink already, I'll text back inside 15 minutes with an honest ETA
Outside the service area, I'll point you to a colleague I trust rather than promise something I can't deliver
If it's life-safety — fire, gas leak you can smell from outside, structural collapse — call 911 first, then call me
